about: Mission Eats (Voice AI calls, live DB 2026-10-18): the business stated its tax rate and confirmed the agent's all-in read-back, yet the deal board said 'Tax isn't included' (flag tax_excluded). Claude followed the old prompt rule 'a rate goes in tax_rate_percent with tax_included false', so a confirmed all-in total that already contains the tax was flagged. Each case pairs the real (or, where marked synthetic, a realistic) transcript with what Claude returns under the per-quote tax judgement (tax_status + tax_rate_percent + tax_evidence) and, for the real misses, the live Claude output. Phone numbers removed. Tests: packages/engine/tests/taxUnderstanding.test.ts.
